source_text.GH#2547: TENANT_ADMIN can be obtained through six paths and several write no audit (group-member add, IdP claim sync without strip, admin tokens without membership). ACs: (1) every TA grant/removal path audited with actor, target user, before/after, UTC time, trace id, one test per path; (2) IdP strip semantics decided and tested vs 0051 M3, manual membership never stripped; (3) admin-count helper = distinct owning users of TA-group members plus active unexpired TA tokens (supervisor refinement), used by 0051 N1 guard and 0053 D6 publish check, tested; (4) no new grant path, existing audited paths unchanged. Gates: SECURITY-REVIEWER (INV-4, INV-6), REVIEWER. Only GH comment so far is the letflow heartbeat (2026-10-14T15:30Z), no AC revision.

task.description: WF-03 step 1 diagnosis for GH #2547 (TENANT_ADMIN grant/removal paths, audit completeness, IdP strip semantics, admin-count helper). Diagnosis only: no lib/ or test edits, no mix commands (machine memory constraint; ORCH runs tests later).

result.summary: DIAGNOSIS (CONFIRMED BY CODE READING; per ORCH instruction no mix command was run, so no runtime repro; every claim below is a file:line read on main ee6cb26b6). Registry Step 0.5: no prior docs/issues entry matches (ISS-1023/1029/1109 hit the grep but are promotion/auditor issues); not a recurrence. CLASS: security/audit-completeness gap, pre-existing, not a regression. Where 'TA holder' is decided at runtime: OIDC branch = group_members JOIN tenant_role(kind :platform_role, name TENANT_ADMIN) read live per request (Identity.list_effective_role_names/2, identity.ex:832-846; called from auth_pipeline.ex:386-401, which also 403s users.status :inactive). API-token branch = api_tokens.roles read live (verify_api_token, identity.ex:1694-1719; auth_pipeline.ex:148-157), and it does NOT check users.status (see finding F1). == PATH ENUMERATION (grant G / removal R; audit status on main) == (a) G: POST /identity/groups/:id/members (routers/identity.ex:206 -> handle_add_member :655) -> Identity.add_group_member/3 (identity.ex:617-630) -> insert_or_fetch_group_member/3 (identity.ex:2071-2098). NO audit, no actor/trace threaded (opts = scoped_opts = prefix only). (a') R: DELETE /groups/:id/members/:user_id (routers/identity.ex:214, :740-751) -> Identity.remove_group_member/3 (identity.ex:789-802), bare Repo.delete_all. NO audit; the router knows nothing of TA (only with_platform_admin_group_guard). (b) G/R: TA binding moved to another group. On main: POST /roles upsert silently overwrites group_id (role_registry.ex insert_or_update_role, on_conflict set group_id) -> NO audit; RoleRegistry has no Audit call at all on main. PR #2537 (open, CI green, not merged) makes POST /roles 409 role_already_bound and adds POST /roles/:id/rebind -> RoleRegistry.rebind_role/4 writing 'role.rebound'. (b') G: POST /roles CREATING a TENANT_ADMIN binding (no binding exists yet) pointing at an already-populated group grants TA to every member at once; unaudited on main AND still unaudited after #2537 (design gh2524 sec.3 item 1 'Create: unchanged'). Reachable only when no TA binding exists (legacy/unseeded tenant or after a failed seed); H2 limits it to :UsersGroupsRolesManage holders (routers/identity.ex ~905-915). (c) G: pending-admin-grant first-login bind (auth_pipeline.ex:350-367 -> PendingAdminGrants.bind_on_login/5 :379 -> transact_bind :518-580, membership via Identity.add_group_member :535). AUDITED: 'tenant.admin_grant.bound' (tenant chain) + 'platform.tenant_admin_grant.bound' (platform chain), actor = bound user, trace_id nil (:545,:558), before_state nil. Revoke of an open pending grant (PendingAdminGrants.revoke :274, audited, trace from opts) removes a FUTURE grant only. (d) G: IdP role-claim sync Identity.sync_role_claims_from_token/3 (identity.ex:877-946), called from upsert_by_external_identity :2253-2254, insert_or_fetch :2280 and :2289-2290, all inside provision_oidc_user (identity.ex:129) from auth_pipeline.ex:331. Writes group_members for EVERY claimed platform-role name incl. TENANT_ADMIN (resolve_group_ids_for_role_names :962-979). NO audit. It is ONE-TIME per user: gated on users.role_claims_synced_at == nil and the marker is stamped when >=1 row was written (:905-927). Consequence: after the first successful sync IdP claims are never read again, so a disappearing TA claim is never stripped AND a later-added TA claim is never granted. This is the deliberate REQ-378 'revocation-permanence' invariant (lib/letflow/design/req378-oidc-live-revocation-check.md sec.2.2.4; iss-0773 design :168-180): re-reading claims on every login would re-grant memberships an admin revoked. (d') G: RoleBackfill bulk-resets role_claims_synced_at to nil for every user (role_backfill.ex:200-211, ISS-0910; mix letflow.backfill_platform_roles) -> every user re-syncs from claims on next login, re-granting TA (incl. admin-revoked TA) through (d). The reset itself is unaudited. Not in the issue's six-path list. (e) G: TenantAdminMigration (mix letflow.migrate_tenant_admins / release rpc): copies PLATFORM_ADMIN-group members into the TA group via Repo.insert_all (tenant_admin_migration.ex:353-366) audited 'group_member.copied'; ensure_binding(nil) creates the TA binding (:339); (e') token rewrite PLATFORM_ADMIN->TENANT_ADMIN (:376-396) audited 'token.roles_migrated'. All audit!/6 (:403) with actor nil, trace nil (CLI context). (f) G: POST /tokens (routers/identity.ex:223) -> Identity.create_token/3 (identity.ex:1454-1468, insert_token :1498-1545) with roles incl. TENANT_ADMIN. AUDITED 'token.create' but actor_id nil and trace_id nil (:1521-1534); after_state carries user_id and roles (token_hash excluded). create_token does NOT check the owner's or minter's roles (0051 M2 gap, owned by #2533, not this issue). (f') R: DELETE /tokens/:id -> revoke_token/2 (identity.ex:1626-1674). AUDITED 'token.revoke', actor nil, trace nil. (f'') R: token expiry is passive (verify_api_token :1710-1713); no event exists or can exist; expires_at is in the mint audit's after_state. OTHER CANDIDATES CHECKED: tenant provisioning/onboarding seed (tenant_onboarding.ex:189 -> RoleRegistry.seed_default_platform_role_groups/1) creates an EMPTY group named TENANT_ADMIN and binds it, unaudited, but grants nobody; on main the seed also 'repairs' a moved TA binding back to the group named TENANT_ADMIN (silent re-grant to that group's members; #2537 sec.4.3 removes this). Group deletion: delete_group/2 (identity.ex:674-702) refuses a group with members and a bound group (ISS-1032 FK), so it can never remove TA from anyone. Role binding delete: no route; only TenantAdminMigration deletes the legacy PLATFORM_ADMIN binding. User deactivation (update_user_status, identity.ex:384, audited 'user.update_status', actor nil, trace nil): removes effective TA for the OIDC branch only (F1). No user-delete function exists. No raw-SQL writer of group_members exists (grep 'group_members' in lib/ excluding design). PLATFORM_ADMIN in the platform tenant is not TENANT_ADMIN (dropped outside the platform tenant, auth_pipeline.ex:411). == F1 (separate defect, out of AC4 scope, recommend filing via letflow-2): the API-token branch never checks users.status, so a deactivated user's TENANT_ADMIN token keeps authenticating as TENANT_ADMIN (auth_pipeline.ex:148-157 vs :386-401). == AUDIT API / EVENT SHAPE == Letflow.Audit.append_multi(multi, step, attrs, prefix) (audit.ex:182-189) and Audit.insert_entry(repo, attrs, prefix) (audit.ex:231-260); attrs: actor_id (uuid|nil, required key), action (free string), resource_type, resource_id, before_state, after_state, trace_id (optional); timestamp = DateTime.utc_now() set inside insert_entry (UTC, microsecond) and covered by the hash chain (audit.ex:61,69). role.rebound (#2537 role_registry.ex move_role): Audit.insert_entry(Repo, %{actor_id: caller, action: 'role.rebound', resource_type: 'tenant_role', resource_id: role.id, before_state: %{name,kind,group_id}, after_state: %{name,kind,group_id,reason}, trace_id: nil}, prefix) inside the same Repo.transaction, audit error -> Repo.rollback({:audit_failed, _}) -> 500. NOTE: role.rebound ALSO writes trace_id nil, so AC1's trace-id requirement for path (b) is not met by #2537 as written. Event names are already fixed by 0051 D8: 'group_member.added', 'group_member.removed' (with role/from/to delta), 'token.created', 'role.rebound', 'grant.sync_suppressed'; existing code uses 'token.create'/'token.revoke' (AC4 says keep existing paths unchanged -> keep names, enrich actor/trace). Target user: for group events resource_type 'group_member' or 'user' with target user_id in states; for tokens target = after_state.user_id (already present). == TRACE ID AVAILABILITY == HTTP /api/v1: Letflow.Api.Context.assign_trace_id/1 (api/context.ex:160-169) runs in ApiPipeline BEFORE AuthPipeline (api_pipeline.ex:232), sets conn.assigns[:trace_id] and Logger.metadata(trace_id:). Routers already use conn.assigns[:trace_id] (onboarding.ex:523, tenants.ex:370, tenant_settings.ex:141); routers/identity.ex does not yet, and scoped_opts carries prefix only, so actor (conn.assigns.auth_context.user_id) and trace must be threaded explicitly into add/remove_group_member, create_token, revoke_token (and rebind_role). OIDC sync + pending bind: run inside AuthPipeline in the same request process after assign_trace_id, so conn.assigns[:trace_id] is in scope in provision_user/3 and bind_pending_admin/4 (auth_pipeline.ex:326-367) but is NOT threaded (provision_oidc_user opts = prefix only; bind passes trace nil). Actor for sync = the user themself (or nil with a 'source: idp_sync' marker; designer decides). Background/CLI (TenantAdminMigration, RoleBackfill): no trace exists; Letflow.Obs.Logger.with_trace/1 (obs/logger.ex:206-220) generates one into Logger.metadata. == PROVENANCE == group_members has no provenance: schema = group_id, user_id, inserted_at only (identity/group_member.ex:21-26; migration 20260822000102). IdP-sync rows, admin-added rows, pending-grant rows and migration-copied rows are indistinguishable. The only per-user trace is users.role_claims_synced_at (per user, not per row). A strip that spares manual rows therefore NEEDS a tenant-scoped migration adding e.g. group_members.source ('manual'|'idp_sync'|'admin_grant'|'migration'), registered in TenantProvisioning.tenant_scoped_migrations (tenant_provisioning.ex ~555), with existing rows backfilled to a non-strippable value (unknown provenance must be treated as manual, fail-safe). == STRIP SEMANTICS (recommendation) == 0051 M3 governs only what sync WRITES, never removal: 'M3 (SUPERSEDES open point 5 "tenant-wide wins" as a sync default): tenant-wide wins only WITHIN a principal. Before enforcement, IdP/JIT sync writes a `tenant_wide` row. After enforcement, sync writes NO row (the user is denied until an admin grants scope) and emits an audited "binding pending scope" event; sync never adds or keeps `tenant_wide` for a user who has scoped rows (`grant.sync_suppressed`). Group-member add audits the effective-scope delta (D1, D8).' (0051:58-62). RECOMMENDED for this PR: KEEP (no strip) = state and test the existing one-time-sync semantics: IdP claim removal never removes a membership; TA removal is an explicit, audited admin act (group_member.removed). Reasons: (1) consistent with REQ-378 revocation-permanence and with M3 (which never has sync remove anything and moves toward 'sync writes nothing' after enforcement); (2) no schema change; (3) AC2 explicitly allows 'kept'; (4) a manual membership is trivially never stripped. Tests: synced TA user logs in again without the TA claim -> still TA, no membership change, no audit event; manual TA member with marker nil logs in without TA claim -> membership kept. ALTERNATIVE if the designer/supervisor wants IdP revocation to propagate: 'strip-only re-evaluation' on every OIDC login (never re-add after the first sync, to keep revocation-permanence), only rows with source = idp_sync, audited group_member.removed with source idp_sync and no claim values (0051 N3 / INV-4), and the N1 zero-admin guard must apply to the strip too. Costs: migration + per-login query + interaction with N1 that #2533 owns. == ADMIN-COUNT HELPER == Neither consumer exists on main: grep lib/ for solo_audited|scripts.sod|ScriptsPublish|last_admin|zero_admin|admin_count -> no matches; 0051 stage 1 (#2533) and stage 2 (#2535) are OPEN issues, role_scope_grants does not exist; 0053 D6 publish/solo_audited is not implemented (#2534 stage 1 open). So 'used by' in this PR can only mean: ship the public API + tests and name it as the mandatory source for N1 and D6 (record it on #2533 and #2534 / 0053 D6 requirement); there is no call site to wire. Recommended shape: Identity.tenant_admin_user_ids(opts) and tenant_admin_count(opts) = COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) over UNION of (group_members JOIN tenant_role name='TENANT_ADMIN' kind=:platform_role) and (api_tokens WHERE 'TENANT_ADMIN' = ANY(roles) AND revoked_at IS NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())), both JOIN users WHERE status = :active (0051 N1: 'counts only active admins'; 0053 D6: '>= 2 tenant-wide TENANT_ADMIN users' -> distinct users). A token owned by a TA-group member counts once (DISTINCT user_id). OWNERLESS TOKEN: impossible: api_tokens.user_id is NOT NULL with FK to users (migration 20260823000001:29; ApiToken.insert_changeset validate_required :user_id, api_token.ex:49), and no user-delete exists, so every token has an owner; the helper can inner-join users. Pre-0051 every TA is tenant-wide, so no scope filter yet; #2533 must add 'tenant-wide only' when role_scope_grants lands. N1 also needs 'under a lock': the helper should accept being called inside the caller's transaction (take a repo/prefix and do no transaction of its own); the lock choice (e.g. FOR UPDATE on the TA tenant_role row) belongs to the N1 implementer. == OVERLAP == Only open PR touching identity code is #2537 (role_registry.ex, routers/identity.ex, authorization.ex). This fix touches routers/identity.ex (add/remove member, tokens handlers) and identity.ex; textual conflict risk in routers/identity.ex is moderate (different handlers, moduledoc route list both edited). Sequence after #2537 merges (as the heartbeat says) and rebase; path (b) audit is then #2537's role.rebound, plus a trace_id follow-up. Double-audit hazard: PendingAdminGrants.transact_bind calls Identity.add_group_member inside its own Multi (:535); if the audit is put inside add_group_member/3, the bind path gains an extra group_member.added entry (changes an existing audited path, AC4). Designer must choose: audit at a layer the bind does not go through, or an explicit opt. Same for sync_role_claims_from_token, which calls the private insert_or_fetch_group_member/3 directly. == REQ == A REQ entry is needed (functional change: audit events on new paths, new public helper, possibly a migration). Per instructions, ID allocation is letflow-2's; this step did not allocate one. == OPEN QUESTIONS FOR CODE-DESIGNER == Q1 strip semantics: KEEP (recommended, no migration) vs strip-only with provenance column; needs supervisor confirmation since the issue text frames 'does not strip' as a defect. Q2 audit scope of (a): audit every add/remove on ANY group (0051 D8 group_member.added/removed) or only on the TA-bound group (AC1 minimum)? Recommend every group with a TA-delta field, since D8 needs it later anyway; confirm no scope creep. Q3 should sync (d) audit every platform role it writes or only TA? Q4 token.create vs D8 'token.created' naming; keep existing name per AC4? Q5 actor for IdP sync and for the pending bind (self vs nil + source marker) and trace threading into provision_oidc_user/4 opts. Q6 does AC1 cover (b') POST /roles create of a TA binding over a populated group, (d') RoleBackfill marker reset and user deactivation (already audited as user.update_status but actor/trace nil)? Recommend: audit (b') as part of this issue (it is a grant path); (d') and deactivation get actor/trace enrichment only if cheap; otherwise list them as follow-ups. Q7 role.rebound trace_id nil in #2537: enrich here after #2537 merges, or a follow-up issue? Q8 helper: exclude tokens of inactive owners (recommended, N1 'active admins') while F1 means such tokens still authenticate; file F1 separately. Q9 'used by' for AC3: confirm with supervisor that 'API + tests + documented contract on #2533/#2534' satisfies AC3, since no consumer exists on main.
